title: net1 v6 over a typical cellular episode: every LCF's truth, belief and 90% interval (R4.2)
description: experiments/lcf_timeseries.py on exp-net1v6-cellular-207's episodes, which it plotted at the episode whose capacity varies most, on cellular traces often a link that is mostly out. This plots the typical one instead: for Cubic and for BBRv1, alone, the episode with the median variation of capacity (lcf-*.png), with each LCF's mean, mean absolute error and 90% coverage over it (lcf-*.txt). net1 v6 is model-v6-inputs' seed 0.
run: for c in cubic bbr; do uv run --with matplotlib==3.10.0 python experiments/lcf_timeseries.py "$OUT/lcf-$c.png" "$IN/m/net1-v6-s0.pt" "$IN/c/c-cellular-30" --controller "$c" > "$OUT/lcf-$c.txt"; done
